ใช้ได้ในบางสูตร โดยต้องเลือกชนิดและปริมา: It can be used in some formulations, provided the type and amount of denaturants are suitable for the product. In the US system, TTB lists several specially denatured alcohol formulas for perfume production, so undenatured ethanol is not always required.
สำหรับ ETOH ที่จะนำไปใช้ ต้องยืนยันสูตรส: For the ETOH product under consideration, confirm its denaturant formulation, specifications and destination-market requirements, then test odour, clarity and stability with the actual fragrance concentrate. PHARMOL is an option when the formulation requires undenatured ethanol.
